title: Structured authored evidence content, version 1
description: JSON following the exact HYPRN evidence/1 newline prefix in an evidence note's content. The entire stored content remains bounded to 4096 characters. Author-supplied transcription, not authenticated document extraction. All four fields are explicit; legacy content without the prefix remains uninterpreted prose.

excerpt.description: Verbatim source text. Do not paraphrase or invent.

source_reference.description: Source title, citation or URL identifying the quoted document.

location.description: Printed page reference, or an explicit section/table/figure locator for an unpaginated source. Never infer a page.

explanation.description: Author reasoning about the specific claim, applicable conditions and limits; never a quotation.
